verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists "定时任务" (scheduled tasks) among its general features. That suggests a first-party recurring automation capability, but the only evidence is a single index-level mention. Agent-mode and autonomous coding claims describe one-off, conversation-driven tasks, not background automations. Missing for 10: documentation of how scheduled tasks are configured, what actions they can run autonomously in the background, triggers beyond time-based schedules, limits, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
